scheme_name: Vahan Aksmat Sahay Scheme
description: The scheme aims to provide immediate medical assistance and financial support to road traffic accident victims. It offers comprehensive medical treatment packages for various injury types with cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals.
benefits:
**Medical Treatment Packages** Comprehensive treatment packages ranging from ₹1,000/- to ₹45,000/- covering various types of injuries:
**Package-wise Benefits** - Simple Injury-I (Package 1): ₹1,000/- for treating simple wounds, injection Tetanus Vaccination, analgesic, antibiotics, general conditions check, cleaning, suturing and dressing - Simple Injury-II (Package 2): ₹2,500/- including face and scalp wounds, change of soiled cloth with disposable dress, intravenous line, multiple lacerated wounds suturing - Deglove Injury of Extremities (Package 3): ₹12,000/- for wound debridement in operation theatre under anaesthesia, intravenous line, intravenous antibiotics, remaining wounds suturing and inpatient treatment - Simple Fracture Without Anaesthesia (Package 4): ₹1,500/- for closed reduction, cleaning, suturing, dressing of wounds, fracture stabilization with splint - Closed Fracture Reduction Under Anaesthesia for First Fracture (Package 5): ₹4,000/- including closed fracture reduction under short general anaesthesia with plastering and inpatient treatment - Closed Fracture Reduction Under Anaesthesia for Additional Fracture (Package 6): ₹5,500/- for additional fractures with similar treatment as Package 5 - Dislocation Reduction Under Anaesthesia (Package 7): ₹8,000/- for joint dislocation reduction under general anaesthesia and inpatient treatment - Open Reduction Internal Fixation-Small Bone (Package 8): ₹17,250/- including internal/external fixation of fracture in compound fractures, flap cover and inpatient treatment - Open Reduction Internal Fixation-Large Bone (Package 9): ₹40,250/- for large bone fractures with similar treatment as Package 8 - Inter Costal Drainage One Side (Package 10): ₹8,000/- including intercostal drainage and inpatient treatment - Inter Costal Drainage Bilateral (Package 11): ₹11,000/- for bilateral intercostal drainage with inpatient treatment - Inter Costal Drainage Bilateral with Intensive Care Unit (Package 12): ₹12,000/- with Intensive Care Unit stay - Inter Costal Drainage Bilateral with Intensive Care Unit and Ventilator (Package 13): ₹14,000/- including ventilator support - Blunt Injury Abdomen (Package 14): ₹10,000/- for suspected blunt injury abdomen with stabilization as inpatient - Blunt Injury Abdomen with Intensive Care Unit Stay (Package 15): ₹12,000/- including Intensive Care Unit stay - Supra Pubic Cystostomy (Package 16): ₹5,000/- including supra pubic cystectomy and inpatient treatment - Immobilization for Suspected Spine Injury (Package 17): ₹5,000/- for non-operative management using spinal brace/collar - Cervical Spine Injury-Skeletal Tong Traction (Package 17): ₹25,000/- with tong traction - Spine Injuries with Computed Tomography/Magnetic Resonance Imaging (Package 18): ₹7,000/- including Computed Tomography scan/Magnetic Resonance Imaging - Tracheostomy (Package 19): ₹5,000/- for tracheostomy procedure - Head Injury with Intensive Care Unit Stay Conservative (Package 20): ₹7,000/- for non-operative management with Intensive Care Unit stay - Head Injury with Intensive Care Unit Stay with Ventilator (Package 21): ₹15,000/- including ventilator support - Head Injury with Intensive Care Unit Surgical Intervention (Package 22): ₹25,000/- for operative management including burr hole surgery - Blood Transfusion (Package 23): ₹1,500/- per unit (maximum admissible 3 units) - Road Traffic Accident Injuries Associated with Burns Conservative Management (Package 24): ₹4,000/- for conservative management of burns - Intensive Care Unit Stay Other than Head Injury (Package 25): ₹4,000/- for non-head injury Intensive Care Unit care - Pelvic Injury-Conservative Management (Package 26): ₹20,000/- for non-operative management with pelvic belt and traction - Pelvic Injury-External Fixation with Implant (Package 27): ₹45,000/- for stabilization with external fixation and haemodynamic stabilization
**Mode of Disbursement** Cashless Treatment: Treatment provided at empanelled hospitals without upfront payment.
documents_required:
At Time of Treatment
Scanned Copy of Medico Legal Case Register Showing the Details of Injury
Police Intimation Copy with Police Acknowledgment
Two Photos Showing the Wound Before and After Treatment with Patient Face Clearly Along with the Treating Doctor (Includes Patient Photo for Identity)
Out-Patient Record/Case Sheet Details Showing the Treatment Given (Including Operation Theatre Notes If Any)
Investigation Done Report
Hospital Bill
 
Package-Specific Additional Documents
For Fracture Cases: X-Rays To Rule Out Fracture, X-Ray Showing the Fracture Before and After Stabilization
For Chest Injuries: Chest X-Ray Before and After Intercostal Drainage
For Abdominal Injuries: Blood Investigation, Chest X-Ray and X-Ray of Erect Abdomen, Ultrasound, Computed Tomography Scan Report (If Required), Electrocardiogram with Report (If Required)
For Spine Injuries: X-Ray Spine Anterior Posterior/Lateral, Computed Tomography/Magnetic Resonance Imaging
For Head Injuries: Computed Tomography Scan Report, Other Relevant Investigations

scheme_name: VAIshwik BHArtiya Vaigyanik (VAIBHAV) Fellowship
description:
VAIBHAV Fellowship envisages collaboration between scientists of Indian Diaspora with
Indian Higher Educational Institutions/Universities/Public Funded Scientific
Institutions. Fellow would identify an Indian Institution for collaboration &
may spend upto two months in a year for a max. of 3 years.
benefits:
> **Emoluments for the Fellowship:**

  - Fellowship in ₹4,00,000/- roughly (equivalent to USD 5000 per month), for a minimum of 1 month and a maximum of up to 2 months per year for a period of a maximum of 3 years,
  - International Travel from place of work in parent institute to place of work in India in business class once a year,
  - Fully furnished Accommodation in the guest house or hotel up to ₹7500/- per day,
  - Contingency ₹1,00,000 per year for research expenditure in India

  - Domestic Travel (economy class) for academic purposes up to two Indian academic/scientific institutes in a year.

**Note:** It may be noted that the total eligible grant will be released to the Indian host Institute and these institutes will be providing a Fellowship amount to the VAIBHAV Fellow and extend other support.
> **Institutional Financial Support:**

The financial support (up to ₹5 Lakhs per year for 3 years) will be given to the host institution to facilitate the VAIBHAV fellow for research work as per DST norms. This funding will cover the following expenses in connection with a project;

  - Consumables and Accessories,
  - Contingency
  - Institutional Overhead

description: The scheme aims to promote tourism-based self-employment and entrepreneurship among unemployed residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance and subsidies for the development of tourism-related infrastructure and services. This scheme is applicable in entire Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under this scheme, both vehicle items (ordinary bus, taxi, max, electric bus) and non-vehicle items (hotel/paying guest scheme, construction of motor garage/workshop, establishment of fast food centres, establishment of Sadhna Kutir Yoga Meditation centres, adventure activities, establishment of modern tourist information centres with P.C.O. facility, development of tented residential facilities, establishment of sales centres for local handicrafts and symbolic items, establishment of bakery, establishment of laundry, purchase of equipment for terrain bikes, star gazing and bird watching for tourism, herbal tourism, purchase and operation of kayaking/boats, caravan/motor home tourism, purchase of angling equipment, construction of museums containing memorabilia and establishment of memorabilia/souvenir centres, construction of floating hotels, and establishment of centres for providing trekking equipment, suits, jackets, etc. on rent) are included. Apart from the above, applicants can also submit any innovative project based on the attractions and characteristics of their particular area. **The following grants/subsidies are provided under the scheme:** (a) **Non-vehicle items:** A grant of up to 33% of the project cost, with a maximum of ₹33.00 lakh in hilly areas, and up to 25% of the project cost, with a maximum of ₹25.00 lakh in plain areas. (b) **Vehicle items:** A grant of up to 25% of the project cost, with a maximum of ₹10.00 lakh in both hilly and plain areas. For specific buses/electric buses—pushback 30 and 42 seater (2*2), pushback 26–28 seater, and 42 seater (2*2) electric/air-conditioned buses—a grant of 50% of the project cost, up to a maximum of ₹20.00 lakh, is provided. scheme_name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes
ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship among Scheduled Caste individuals by providing concessional finance. Benefits include investment ranging from ₹10,00,000/- to ₹15,00,00,000/- as debt or equity for eligible Private Limited or Public Limited companies.
benefits: ##### ***Size of Financial Assistance*** - Financial assistance available ranges from ₹10,00,000/- (minimum) to ₹15,00,00,000/- (maximum). - Aggregate financial assistance must not exceed two times the current net worth of the Company. ##### ***Funding Tenure*** - The maximum tenure for financial assistance is up to 10 years, including the moratorium period in the case of debentures. - In the case of equity, the decision for exit would be taken on a case-to-case basis, with a maximum tenure up to 10 years. ##### ***Returns/Coupons/Interest Rate*** - For debt/convertible instruments, the interest/coupon rate is 4% per annum. - For Scheduled Caste women entrepreneurs and disabled entrepreneurs accessing debt/convertible instruments, the interest/coupon rate is 3.75% per annum. - In equity investment, the return at the time of exit by way of buyback, strategic investment, or Initial Public Offering (IPO) shall be 8% per annum or as per the valuation, whichever is higher. ##### ***Working Capital Gap Funding*** - The fund offers working capital gap funding, where a maximum of 20% of the total financial assistance should be earmarked for this purpose for the next 10 years. - The quantum of such assistance shall be approved by the Investment Committee as per the requirement of the project, on a case-to-case basis. ##### ***Technology Business Incubator (TBI) Funding*** - Innovative ideas selected by Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) may receive funding to cover the cost of operation and maintenance. - This funding is subject to a ceiling of ₹10,00,000/- on an average per year for a period of three years, subject to satisfactory progress. ##### ***Moratorium Period for Principal Redemption*** - In the case of debentures, the moratorium period for the redemption of the principal is on a case-to-case basis, but not more than 36 months from the date of investment in the Company. ##### ***Cost Bearing for Documentation*** - The fees for the Valuer and the Lawyer for conducting valuation and title search of the property(ies) shall be borne by the Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC) for the first time. ##### ***Disbursement*** - For financial assistance up to ₹5,00,00,000/-, investment shall be funded maximum up to 75% of the project cost, and the balance 25% must be funded by the promoters or through Government subsidy under various schemes. - For financial assistance above ₹5,00,00,000/-, investment shall be funded maximum up to 50% of the project cost. - For financial assistance above ₹5,00,00,000/-, at least 25% of the project cost shall be funded by promoters or through Government subsidy under various schemes, and the balance 25% can be funded either by promoters, a bank, or any other Financial Institution. - For companies with sanctioned assistance of above ₹5,00,00,000/-, the money released by the Trust/Fund Manager would be in proportion to the loan tranche/promoter’s contribution released by a Bank/department of Government of India, except in cases supported under the Innovative ideas category selected by Technology Business Incubators (TBIs). - The investment disbursement shall be made in tranches. - The disbursement shall be made post execution of the complete legal documents. - Disbursement is subject to the completion of the sanctioned terms, pre-disbursement conditions, and the successful completion of Valuation and Title Search Report (TSR). ##### ***Conditions*** - _Interest/Coupon payment shall commence from the date of investment in the Company._ - _Interest payments will be made quarterly by the company to Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC)._ - _The shareholding of Scheduled Castes entrepreneurs (at least 51%) has to be maintained till the assistance under this fund is present in the company._ - _If working capital assistance is extended to existing beneficiaries, the account must be standard._ - _If working capital assistance is extended to existing beneficiaries, the beneficiary company should have applied to nationalized/private/cooperative Banks for working capital assistance._ - _In cases where Government subsidy is available, the promoters will have to contribute at least 15% of the project cost._ - _If any modification is requested by the Company/Promoters for change in the property after the first valuation/title search, the fees for the Valuer and Lawyer shall be borne by the Company/Promoters._

scheme_name: Vishesh Katan, Vankari & Vanat Sahay (Spinning & Weaving Assistance Scheme)
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in addition to the central government assistance to spinners and weavers. It provides production incentives to Khadi spinners and weavers with category-wise differential assistance rates.
benefits:
> **For Spinners** - General and Scheduled Caste Categories: Additional ₹1/- per hank for spinning of yarn. - Women and Scheduled Tribe Categories: Additional ₹1.5/- per hank for spinning of yarn. > **For Weavers** - General and Scheduled Caste Categories: Additional ₹3/- per square meter for weaving of Khadi. - Scheduled Tribe Category: Additional ₹4/- per square meter for weaving of Khadi. - Weaving Equipment Aid: ₹1/- per square meter weaving equipment aid.
> **Mode and Frequency of Disbursement** - Production incentive based on actual spinning and weaving output. - Payment structure linked to per hank for spinning and per square meter for weaving. > **Conditions for Availment/Continuation** - Beneficiaries must be actively engaged in Khadi spinning and weaving activities. - Incentives are provided in addition to central government assistance. - Must maintain production records for verification purposes.
documents_required:
At Application StageApplication Form As Prescribed By Gujarat Rajya Khadi Gramodyog Board.
Proof Of Identity And Category Certificate (For Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women Categories).
Production Records And Details Of Spinning/Weaving Activities.
Registration Details With Khadi Institution Or Board.
At Verification Stage
Production Evidence And Output Documentation For Incentive Calculation.
Bank Account Details For Direct Benefit Transfer.
Any Additional Documents As Required By Gujarat Rajya Khadi Gramodyog Board.

scheme_name: Visiting Advanced Joint Research Faculty Scheme
description: VAJRA Faculty Scheme is a dedicated program exclusively for overseas scientists and academicians with emphasis on NRI and Persons of Indian Origin/Overseas Citizen of India to work as adjunct/visiting faculty for a specific period of time in Indian Public funded academic and research institutions.
benefits:
1. The residency period of VAJRA Faculty in India would be for a minimum of 1 month and a maximum of 3 months.
   1. VAJRA Faculty will be provided US$ 15000 in the first month of engagement and US$ 10000 p.m. in the subsequent two months. While no separate support is provided for travel, accommodation, medical/personal insurance, etc. the host institute may consider providing additional support.
   1. **Return visit of Indian faculty to the Institute of VAJRA Faculty:** One research visit by the Indian host to the Institute of the VAJRA Faculty for a period not less than a week and not exceeding 30 days will be supported. The board will provide return economy airfare, not exceeding ₹1.5 lakhs per diem, and accommodation as per the norms of the Board.   1. **Student mobility (Doctoral &amp; Postdoctoral Level: Across labs):** Collaborative research visit of not more than 2 students, doctoral, preferably co-advised / post-doctoral level after 2 years of engagement from the research group of Indian host to the Institute of the VAJRA Faculty for a duration of three to six months will be supported. The board will provide a return economy airfare, a one-time contingency grant of ₹60,000/- and fellowship equivalent to the norms of the Board.   1. **Research Contingency Grant to the hosting Indian Collaborator:** ₹5.0 lakhs per year of research visit per VAJRA Faculty to the Indian host to meet expenses related to the collaborative research will also be provided.   1. **Support to engage VAJRA Faculty to give lectures in his/her area of expertise in the host Institute:** Support to VAJRA Faculty to the tune of ₹1.0 lakh per year for this activity will be provided.
documents_required:
Passport size photograph
CV of VAJRA Faculty (including academic qualifications, research experience, awards/honors, and a maximum of ten relevant research publications)
Technical details of the proposed work
Certificate from Lead Indian Collaborator
Endorsement Letter from Indian Collaborator Institution
Letter from Institution of VAJRA Faculty
Any other document, as required

1. Have a soft copy of your Photograph ready (maximum 1MB).
2. Once mobile numbers and emails are registered, they cannot be changed.
3. You can submit multiple applications in the same or different categories/subcategories.
4. Soft copies of the current resume, technical information, report of functional efficiency, and details of any external evaluation done should be kept ready beforehand in pdf format and size should not exceed 10MB each.
5. You will need to provide details like name, email, and contact number of two referees (one of whom shall be the Vice Chancellor of your University, and the other will be your Director/Dean/Professor familiar with your work) to whom your application will be forwarded for submission of their recommendation online.

scheme_name: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Full Time PhD Candidates
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: The scheme aims at generating a total of 1000 Full-time PhD Candidates in emerging research areas of Electronic System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (ITES) sectors over a period of 5 years.
benefits: [***Financial Support for Full-time PhD candidates***](https://phd.dic.gov.in/guidelines/SOPFullTime.pdf)***:*** 1. **Fellowship:** ₹38,750/- per month in 1st & 2nd year and @₹43,750/- per month in 3rd, 4th and 5th years of PhD. (support till PhD completion or 5 years whichever is earlier). 1. **Reimbursement of Rent (RoR):** This component is linked with the fellowship of a PhD Candidate. The rate of RoR is 24%, 16% & 8% (of fellowship) for X, Y & Z class cities/towns respectively. 1. **Institutional Overheads:** An amount of ₹25,000/Year/Full-time PhD candidate for support duration of PhD candidate to be given to the institution. The institutional overhead will be released after completion of required tenure by the respective candidate on pro-rata basis. 1. **Research Contingency Grant Support:** An amount of ₹1,20,000/Year/Full-time PhD candidate for support duration of the PhD candidate. 1. **Support to attend selected International Conferences** up to ₹1.5 Lakh per Full Time PhD candidate from 3rd year. 1. **One time support for selected 250 Full Time PhD candidates from 3rd year for 6 months “Visit to Labs Abroad”.** The support would be available to the selected Full Time PhD candidates with following guidelines: - During the visit, the Monthly Fellowship will be ₹1.50 Lakh. - The Travel/Visa expenses up to ₹1.50 Lakh is provided. - During this period, the domestic Fellowship and Reimbursement of Rent (RoR) will be suspended.
documents_required:
Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme is an institutional scheme wherein eligible institutions submit proposals requesting Full-time PhD seats against an active call for proposal by Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme, DIC, MeitY. 
1. The call for proposal for Full-time PhD  seats will be notified by PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY through the web portal https://phd.dic.gov.in/  
2. Proposals for allotment of Full-time PhD seats are to be submitted by eligible institutions only. Suitable number of seats would be allotted to institutions for further enrollment of Full-time PhD  fellows on these seats following the scheme guidelines.
Accordingly, the applicants may contact their respective institutions for documents and other formalities.

scheme_name: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Post-Doctoral Fellowships (PDF)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: This fellowship is meant for those who have a proven track record as evident from their research publications & recognitions. Support is provided for 225 Post-Doctoral Fellowships for candidates for a period of 1 year, to encourage specialized research in emerging area.
benefits: ***Nature of Support:*** - **Research Fellowship:** ₹1.08 Lakh/Month - **Contingency Grant:** ₹1 Lakh for 1 year (on re-imbursement and pro-rata basis depending on the period spent under the award). The claim would be submitted by the awardee through respective institution to PhD Cell in prescribed format. - The fellowship is tenable only in India and can be implemented in any of the recognized & eligible academic and R&D institutions. - Contingency Grant can be used for minor equipment, consumables and similar items relevant to the research work. The host institution should provide necessary administrative and infrastructural support for the PDF fellow. - There is no provision for providing research personnel support under the scheme. The fellow is expected to undertake the research objectives by himself/herself during the entire duration of the fellowship. - PDF is a full-time assignment. The fellows are not eligible to receive any other fellowship from any Government or Non-Government source during the tenure of the fellowship. - Post-doctoral positions are non-transferrable. The research work is to be carried out in the same eligible institution at which PDF seat is allocated and the fellow is enrolled. ***Duration of Support:*** - The fellowship is purely a temporary assignment, and is tenable for a period of 1 year.
documents_required:
Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme is an institutional scheme wherein eligible institutions submit proposals requesting PDF seats against an active call for proposal by Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme, DIC, MeitY. 
1.		The call for proposal for PDF seats will be notified by PhD Cell, DIC; MeitY through the web portal https://phd.dic.gov.in 
2.     Proposals for allotment of PDF seats are to be submitted by eligible institutions only. Suitable number of seats would be allotted to institutions for further enrollment of PDF fellows on these seats following the scheme guidelines.
3.	    The institution may design/have its own application form for advertisement of PDF; however, the guidelines for PDF are to be followed.
Accordingly, the applicants may contact their respective institutions for documents and other formalities.

scheme_name: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Young Faculty Research Fellowships

description: This fellowship is meant for Young Faculty having regular position at their institution and proven track record in research. Support is provisioned for 50 candidates, for an initial period of support of 2 years, extendible till 5 years based on performance review.
benefits: ***Nature of Support:*** - **Research Fellowship:** ₹20,000/- per month, in addition to the regular salary - **Research Contingency Grant:** ₹5,00,000/- per year for a maximum of 5 years - The fellowship is tenable only in India and can be implemented in any of the recognized & eligible academic and R&D institution. - Research Contingency Grant can be used for minor equipment, consumables and domestic travel. The host institution should provide necessary administrative and infrastructural support for YFRF. - The fellows are not eligible to receive any other fellowship from any Government or Non-Government source during the tenure of the fellowship. - YFRFs are non-transferrable. The research work is to be carried out in the same eligible institution though which YFRF proposal was submitted. ***Duration of Support:*** - The fellowship is purely a temporary assignment, and is tenable for a maximum period of 05 years. - The award will initially be for 2 years and further extendible, based on performance review.
documents_required: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme is an institutional scheme wherein eligible institutions submit nominations for YFRF against an active call for proposal by Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme, DIC, MeitY. scheme_name: Vocational Training in Tribal Areas
description: The scheme will be implemented for the benefit of the Scheduled Tribes as well as PTGs and can be taken up anywhere in the country but priority will be given to remote tribal areas, areas inhabited by particularly vulnerable tribes, and areas affected by extremist activities.
benefits:
1. Under the scheme, grants will be available for organizing vocational training in recognized institutes or in Vocational Training Centres (VTCs) subject to terms and conditions revised from time to time of the scheme.
   1. The training for trades including modern trades having employment potential in the tribal region will be provided.
   1. Under this scheme, the fund will be provided in two ways: (i) By setting up and running VTCs mainly in remote areas/rural areas deficient in facilities, (ii) By supporting vocational training for ST as also PTG candidates in already existing institutions in townships/districts, etc. like ITIs, Polytechnics, computer training centers, and other private recognized institutions.
   1. Each tribal boy/girl will be trained in one trade of his/her choice and given practical experience as per the syllabus prescribed by the institute. 
   1. After completion of the training, a certificate/diploma will be provided by the institute to the successful trainees.

> **Admissible Financial Norms:** The non-recurring and recurring grant-in-aid will be admissible in accordance with financial norms given as under:

**Recurring:-**
(a) ₹30,000/- per annum per trainee includes:-

   1.  Stipend to trainee @ ₹700/- per month.
   1.  ₹1600/- per trainee per annum for procurement of tools, raw materials, etc.
   1.  Monthly honorarium to faculty/supporting staff etc.
   1.  Boarding/lodging of trainees, electricity and water charges, etc.

(b) In the case of a rented building, annual rent will be admissible in addition to (a) above as per actuals, and the maximum limit will be ₹10,000/- per month. This will be subject to submission of the Rent Assessment Certificate by the Public Works Department of the State Government. If the building is owned by the institution/organization, only 10% of the rental value (authenticated by State PWD), as admissible, will be provided as maintenance charges per annum.
**Non-recurring:-**
(a) ₹2.40 lakh for five trades once in five years @ ₹0.48 lakh per trade.

scheme_name: West Bengal Student Credit Card Scheme
description: The Higher Education Department, Government of West Bengal has introduced the Student Credit Card Scheme for the students of West Bengal to enable them to pursue higher education without having any financial constraints.
benefits:
**Points**

1. The Scheme provides a maximum loan of ₹10,00,000/- at a 4% simple annual interest rate after interest subvention.
1. The interest rate for loans up to ₹10,00,000/- is set at the prevailing 3-year MCLR of State Bank of India plus 1%, fixed at the time of sanction.
1. Students can access the loan at any point during their course of study.
1. Both the student and the parent/legal guardian must co-submit the loan application.
1. An agreement between the student, parents/legal guardians, and the bank will formalize the loan terms.

**Margin money:**

1. Up to ₹4,00,000/-: Nil
1. Above ₹4,00,000/-: 5%
1. Scholarships/assistance ships included
1. Paid pro-rata as disbursements are made

**Security**:

1. No unnecessary restrictions or collateral security
1. No security/collateral other than co-obligation of parents/legal guardians
1. State government to enter separate agreement with banks

**Insurance:**

1. Life cover for student up to loan amount
1. Premium paid by student and debited from loan account

**Time limits:**

1.  The Higher Education Department and the School Education Department will communicate on loan sanctioning and disbursement process timeline after receiving approval from the competent authority.
documents_required:

benefits:
- Each family is provided with a plot of land measuring 5 gunthas (approximately 500 square meters or about 5,382 square feet).
- This plot of land will include the construction of a 269-square-foot home, forming a cluster of 20 families.
- The project will also cover the essential amenities, including shelter, internal roads, drainage, water supply, electricity, and a community hall (Samaj Mandir) for social activities.
- The entire project aims to improve the living standards of VJNT (Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes) families by offering them stable housing and related amenities.
- The benefit of this scheme is given every year to 3 villages amongst 34 districts (except Mumbai & B. Mumbai) to 20 families.  

_*The land for the house shall be given under this scheme on the names of the husband and wife jointly.  However, in the case of widow and divorcee, land and house shall be given by their name._   
_*The land allotted under this scheme is non-transferable, it will not be sold to anyone. The house or land should not be given on rent._
